firm_data.firm_description: Foley Hoag represents public and private clients in a wide range of disputes and transactions. Founded in 1943, they have grown into a unique international firm that blends innovation, deep knowledge and superior legal skill.
notable_facts: Foley Hoag is well known for its commitment to helping clients achieve their desired results across a broad spectrum of legal matters and industries.
The firm has established a lengthy record of success in the innovation industries of life sciences, health care, technology, energy/renewables and cannabis.
Foley Hoag has a strong international litigation and arbitration practice, with an office in Paris.
